title: Meeting a new coworker

lines.speaker: daniel
lines.text: Hi, I'm Daniel. I work with the data team.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Daniel. I'm Maya. I just joined as a project coordinator.

lines.speaker: daniel
lines.text: Welcome to the team! What does your new role involve?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm responsible for planning our projects and keeping everyone on schedule.

lines.speaker: daniel
lines.text: That sounds like a busy job. We'll probably work together on the monthly reports.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Great. Could you tell me a bit more about what your team does?

lines.speaker: daniel
lines.text: Sure. We collect the numbers, check them carefully, and turn them into clear reports for the managers.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's really helpful, thank you. Who should I talk to if I have questions about the data?

lines.speaker: daniel
lines.text: Just come to me. My desk is right over there, by the window.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Perfect. Let's grab a coffee later this week.
